items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Later in life I worked with both of those guys.

ctx.x: And then I listened to a lot of people in town there and the influences were, I heard guys bring in recordings of Stitt & Ammons, I heard a recording of Fats Navarro. I heard a lot of Kenton and a lot of big bands. And then I heard this bass player called Safranski. Ed Safranski. And what I did I said hey that’s pretty good, everybody seems to like it. Because he would feature certain people in certain sections. And so I learned Safranski’s bass part and that taught me some scales. I had to dig for some…
